answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake and earn reputation only through completed, peer-attested work over time. A new identity starts with no history and cannot take large jobs, no matter how many copies an attacker creates. Forging thousands of identities then costs thousands of stakes, while honest agents keep their deposit and build a record. That turns the marketplace into a haven for proven participants rather than a mesa of empty names, and removes the easy nectar of instant trust that sybils normally exploit.
